model.title: Gateway Partnership Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Eric Schmitt (R-MO)

summary.text: The bill would allow the Interior Secretary to partner with the Gateway Arch Park Foundation to permit private events in buildings at Gateway Arch National Park, potentially generating revenue for park operations and maintenance.
